candidates.title: 54 gang members killed in Haiti police raids, authorities say
candidates.originator: Haitian National Police (PNH) statement, reported by The Haitian Times
candidates.why_new: Reports a specific, dated PNH operation in Martissant putting the toll at 54 gang members killed -- a discrete casualty figure not yet in the known-URL corpus, falling in the window since the most recent staged casualty data points (UN human-rights-office Oct 31 tallies staged 2026-11-25). Bears on cadre509's casualty-count cell and on PNH operational tempo for cadre22.

candidates.title: Primer ministro haitiano defiende acuerdo con El Salvador: "La poblacion tiene derecho a un pais sin miedo"
candidates.originator: PM Alix Didier Fils-Aime (statement), reported by Infobae
candidates.why_new: Haiti's PM goes on record defending the Haiti-El Salvador security agreement roughly two weeks after Amnesty International's Nov 10 call (already-dated, not itself staged as stale) for both governments to guarantee Salvadoran forces comply with international human rights law -- a new, dated statement from the Haitian political authority on the legitimacy/accountability of the parallel foreign-force arrangement, relevant to cadre7's command-clarity cell and cadre509's political-authority-instruments cell. Same event also covered in English by riotimesonline.com/haiti-pm-answers-amnesty-gang-fight (undated in that source; staging the dated Infobae piece instead) and by elsalvador.com.
